description: Fixes a process leak where `aspire ls` and `aspire ps` accumulated orphaned NuGet search helper processes that were never awaited or cancelled, causing lock file buildup under `$TMPDIR/NuGetScratch/lock` and potential `dotnet restore` deadlocks. Read-only commands now opt out of unnecessary prefetching, and the prefetch service correctly awaits task completion before shutdown.
name: Fix NuGet search helper process leak in CLI read-only commands
